notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.hint: There is no such address in the tracker — the link may be out of date.

boundary.title: The page failed to render
boundary.hint: This is a bug in the application, not in your data — nothing was lost. Try opening the section again; if it keeps happening, show this message to the developer.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHint: The address comes from your Google account and cannot be changed.

dashboard.intro: The sections build on each other: the year sets the boundaries, classes live inside it, and each class has a schedule and a plan. The list below walks you through it.
dashboard.allDone: Everything is set up. Here is how your classes are doing.

demo.title: Nothing to start from?
demo.hint: Let's build an example: a year with breaks and quarters, two classes, a schedule for the whole year and a plan for one of the classes. See how it all fits together, then remove it with one button.

wipe.title: Start over
wipe.hint: Removes all your data: years, classes, schedules and plans.
wipe.confirm: Delete all your data: the year, classes, schedule and plans? This cannot be undone.

warnings.slot_not_study_day: {{date}} is not a study day ({{statusLabel}}{{titleSuffix}}) — the lesson sits outside the school calendar.
warnings.csv_row_empty: Row {{row}}: neither a section nor a lesson — skipped.
warnings.csv_row_too_long: Row {{row}}: the title is longer than {{limit}} characters — skipped.

errors.downloadFailed: The plan could not be downloaded
errors.year_dates_reversed: The end of the year is earlier than its start.
errors.year_name_taken: You already have a school year with this name.
errors.year_weekend_invalid: A weekday number must be between 0 (Monday) and 6 (Sunday).
errors.year_weekend_full: At least one weekday has to stay a study day.
errors.year_shrink_cuts_exceptions: The new boundaries cut off calendar markup that already exists.
errors.exception_dates_reversed: The end date is earlier than the start date.
errors.exception_outside_year: The period does not fit inside the school year.
errors.term_dates_reversed: The end date is earlier than the start date.
errors.term_outside_year: The term does not fit inside the school year.
errors.class_name_taken: A class with this name already exists in this year.
errors.slot_outside_year: The date is outside the school year ({{start}} — {{end}}).
errors.slot_year_mismatch: The lesson year must match the year of its class.
errors.slot_duplicate: This class already has a lesson with this number on that day.
errors.period_reversed: The end date is earlier than the start date.
errors.period_required: Both a start and an end date are required.
errors.mode_invalid: The mode must be either «replace» or «append».
errors.section_inside_section: A section can only live at the top level.
errors.parent_not_section: A node can only be nested into a section.
errors.parent_other_class: That section belongs to another class.
errors.anchor_other_class: That node belongs to another class.
errors.anchor_other_level: The node to insert after sits on another level.
errors.position_taken: Another node already occupies this position.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{limit_mb}} MB.
errors.file_unreadable: The file could not be read: a plain CSV in UTF-8 or Windows-1251 is expected.
errors.file_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows — split it into parts.
errors.token_required: An id_token or access_token is required.
errors.token_invalid: The Google token is invalid or expired.
errors.email_not_verified: Google has not verified this email address.
errors.no_school: You do not belong to any school yet.
errors.school_admin_required: Only a school administrator can change this.
errors.other_school: That object belongs to another school.
errors.course_in_use: «{{name}}» is in use: {{slots}} lessons and {{plan_rows}} plan rows belong to other teachers. Ask them to clear it first.
errors.course_name_taken: A course with this name already exists in this year.
errors.invitation_exists: «{{email}}» has already been invited to this school.
errors.last_admin: This is the only administrator of the school. Give the role to somebody else first.
errors.superuser_required: Only a superuser can manage the list of schools.
errors.school_in_use: «{{name}}» is still in use: {{blocked_by}}. Clear it first.
errors.not_template_author: Only the author can change this plan. Take a copy and edit that.
errors.subject_required: Pick a subject: the library is searched by subject and grade.
errors.grade_required: Pick a grade: the library is searched by subject and grade.
errors.plan_empty: There is nothing to publish: the plan of this course is empty.
errors.subject_name_taken: This school already has a subject with that name.
errors.content_on_section: A section header holds no lesson content — only a lesson does.
errors.attachment_owner_required: An attachment belongs to exactly one lesson.
errors.attachment_kind_mismatch: Send either a file or a link, not both.
errors.attachment_forbidden: This attachment belongs to somebody else's lesson.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: This kind of file cannot be attached: «{{extension}}». Allowed: images, pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, txt, zip.
errors.school_quota_exceeded: The school has used up its storage quota ({{quota_mb}} MB). Remove some files to make room.
errors.storage_unavailable: The file store is not answering. Everything else works; try the file again in a moment.

clear.title: Clear the period
clear.keepSpecial: leave extra and cancelled lessons alone

copy.title: Copy the schedule
copy.source: Source: {{range}} — {{days}}. Weekdays line up: Mondays land on Mondays.
copy.modeMerge: add to what is already there
copy.preview: About {{created}} lessons will be created, {{skipped}} skipped (non-study days and taken numbers).
copy.checkPeriod: Check the period and the selected classes.

csv.title: Import a plan from CSV
csv.hint: Two columns: the section and the lesson, a third one for a note. The section can stand on its own row or repeat on every lesson row.
csv.dropZone: Drag a file here or choose one
csv.unreadable: The file could not be read — a plain text CSV is expected.
csv.replaceWarning: The current plan of this class will be deleted entirely.

plan.title: Lesson plan
plan.addToSection: Add a lesson to the section
plan.dndInstructions: Press space to pick the item up. Choose a new place with the up and down arrows, press space to drop it, Escape cancels the move. The arrow buttons in the row do the same.

needClass.title: A class first
needClass.hint: A plan is written for a particular class — each one has its own list of sections and lessons.

empty.title: The plan is empty
empty.hint: A list of sections and lessons in order. It will be laid onto the dates of the schedule, and you will see whether the hours last until the end of the year. Add a lesson with the button below or load a ready list from CSV.

removeSection.title: Delete the section «{{title}}»?
removeSection.hint: It holds {{count}}. They can be lifted to the top level — they will take the section's place and keep their order.

plan.publishHint: The plan of this course goes on the shelf as your draft — nobody else sees it until you publish it.
plan.refreshHint: «{{title}}» will be overwritten with the current plan of this course. Colleagues who already took a copy keep theirs.

calendar.title: School year
calendar.deleteYearConfirm: Delete the school year «{{name}}» together with its markup?

empty.title: No school year yet
empty.hint: A school year sets the boundaries lessons are counted inside. Breaks, holidays and terms are marked up here too.
empty.askAdmin: A school year is created by the school administrator.

exceptions.title: Markup
exceptions.typicalHint: autumn, winter and spring — you can move the dates later.
exceptions.hint: Click a day to mark a holiday, or drag across several days to make a break.
exceptions.wholePeriod: «{{title}}» covers a whole period — delete it in the list on the right.

terms.title: Terms
terms.empty: No quarters yet. Without them the layout is counted over the whole year at once.
terms.emptyReadOnly: No quarters have been marked up in this school yet.

calendar.readOnly: The calendar belongs to the school — only an administrator edits it.

classes.title: Classes

needYear.title: A school year first
needYear.hint: A class lives inside a school year: next year 9B becomes 10B, and that is a different class with its own schedule.
needYear.askAdmin: A course lives inside a school year, and the school administrator has not created one yet.

empty.title: No classes yet
empty.hint: A class is what you teach: the group and the subject together, for example «9B Algebra». Each one has its own schedule and its own plan. Type a name above and press Enter.
empty.hintAdmin: A course is a group and a subject together, for example «9B Algebra». Create the first one in the school section.

classes.manageHint: Courses are managed in the school section:
classes.readOnlyHint: Courses are created by the school administrator.

layout.title: Layout
layout.planDoesNotFit: the plan does not fit into the year
layout.total: {{slots}} slots in total, {{lessons}} plan lessons; {{cancelled}} cancelled, {{extra}} extra. The layout is computed on the fly and follows the plan and the schedule by itself.

needClass.title: A class first
needClass.hint: The layout joins the plan to the schedule, and both of them belong to a class.

nothing.title: Nothing to lay out
nothing.hint: This is where the plan meets the schedule: you see which date every lesson lands on and whether there is enough time. Both halves are needed.

leftovers.title: Do not fit into the year
leftovers.hint: These plan lessons ran out of slots — add lessons or shorten the plan.

agenda.title: My schedule
agenda.copyNote: Cancelled and extra lessons are not copied, and the display filter does not affect copying.

empty.title: The schedule is empty
empty.hint: Mark up one week of lessons and copy it across the year — breaks and holidays are skipped automatically. But a class comes first: lessons belong to a class.

add.title: {{date}}, lesson {{number}}
add.nobody: Nobody can take this lesson: every suitable class already has that number taken, the date is outside the school year, or no classes exist yet.

noSchool.title: You do not belong to a school yet
noSchool.hint: The tracker works inside a school: the calendar and the courses come from it. Ask your school administrator to invite this address — they need it exactly as it is written below.
noSchool.superuser: You are a superuser: create a school and add yourself to it in the «Schools» section.

year.title: School year
year.hint: The calendar is shared: the boundaries of the year, the breaks and the quarters are the same for everybody in the school.

courses.title: Courses
courses.hint: A course is a group and a subject together, «9B Algebra». Teachers pick from this list; their lessons and plans inside a course stay their own.

people.title: Teachers
people.hint: An invitation is written before the person first signs in: they get in with the Google account on that address.

schools.title: Schools
schools.hint: Every school in this installation. Creating one and handing it its first administrator cannot be done from inside a school — that is what this section is for.
schools.invited: «{{email}}» is invited to {{name}} as an administrator — they will get in through Google on that address.

empty.title: No schools yet
empty.hint: Create the first one and invite its administrator: everything else — the calendar, the courses, the teachers — they set up themselves.

schoolSchedule.title: School timetable
schoolSchedule.hint: Who teaches what and when. Teachers read it and may copy their own lessons into their schedule once; only an administrator edits it.
schoolSchedule.copyNote: Teachers who have already imported their lessons keep them: a copy is not a sync.

import.title: Load from the school timetable
import.once: The lessons are copied to you once. Later changes to the school timetable will not affect your copy, and your edits will not affect the timetable.
import.skipped: {{count}} will be skipped: the hour is already taken in your schedule.
import.conflicts: {{count}} lessons clash with what you already have
import.modeReplace: replace my schedule for this period
import.replaceWarning: Your lessons in these courses over this period will be deleted, including cancellations and extra lessons.
import.nothing: The school timetable has nothing for you in this period.

library.title: Plan library
library.hint: Plans colleagues have put on the shelf. Taking one gives you a copy: later changes to the template will not follow it.
library.subject: Subject:
library.once: The plan is copied into the course. Later changes to the template will not affect your copy.

empty.title: The library is empty
empty.hint: Nothing has been put on the shelf yet. Publish one of your plans, or write a new one.

placeholders.objectives: MYP objectives this lesson works towards
placeholders.body: Theory and problems. Markdown, maths in $…$ and $$…$$
placeholders.formative: A short check done in the lesson

lesson.discard: The lesson has unsaved changes. Close and lose them?
lesson.sharedHint: The same file is used by another lesson. Removing it here leaves it there.
